mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 2.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in residential sales indicates strengthening labor market and consumer spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and RSAFS increases, or interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in unemployment rate signals labor market improvement that boosts consumer confidence and corporate hiring, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer spending and economic expansion, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5%), a decline in federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5% and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200.0 thousand units, it signals a robust housing market that drives consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
